integrity: Proof given for all finite simple graphs and all binary extension degrees; exhaustive finite test is corroborative only. Independent validation and exhaustive historical priority checking not performed.
scientific_limitations: Binary-structure-constant graphical evolution algebras in characteristic two only; global preperiod-depth and cycle-length counts, not full rooted functional-graph isomorphism. General semilinear reduction uses classical normal-basis and Fitting theory; earlier published Boolean-alphabet rank/cycle formulas are acknowledged.
title: Exact finite-extension orbit census for graphical evolution-algebra squaring
